title: one bundle, several actions — each grounded separately

setup.note: GoldenEvals V6 P1 §5.11 LIV-08, authored at R3. One live flush carries three unrelated-but-related things: Ma asks about the Pune train (S1, a DM), Rohan drops a CCU→GOI fare link (S2, a DM) and a Goibibo fare page is on screen (S3). The recorded live.v1 output prepares TWO actions — draft the reply to Ma, compare the fares — and the assertion is that BOTH survive and that each carries its OWN grounding: there is no one-nudge-per-bundle cap anywhere in the code, and a bundle that justifies two actions gets two. Everything downstream of the model is the real path (pack → live.v1 → critic → commit → applyLiveDecide), so what is graded is the code: grounding per action, no dedupe collapse, both above the intent floor and therefore both on the card surface.

input_events: Ma: "pune wali train ka kya socha?" · Rohan: a CCU→GOI fare link · the same Goibibo fare page on screen — one live flush

expected.note: Two prepared actions out of one bundle, each citing only its own evidence. No cap collapses them and no dedupe merges them: their content keys differ because kind+action+intent+grounding differ.

wrong.label: single-action-cap
wrong.assert_absent: only one prepared action persisted out of a bundle whose evidence justifies two, or two actions merged into one

wrong.label: shared-grounding
wrong.assert_absent: the two actions grounded in the same events — the fare comparison citing Ma's train question, or the reply to Ma citing the Goibibo page
